scripts.setup: bun install && uv sync --project apps/memory --dev && bun run --cwd packages/llm-gateway build
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names host,web "bun --watch apps/eta/src/main.ts --port ${ETA_PORT:-8787} --allow-origin http://127.0.0.1:${ETA_WEB_PORT:-3000} --github" "ETA_HOST_ORIGIN=${ETA_HOST_ORIGIN:-http://127.0.0.1:${ETA_PORT:-8787}} bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.check: dprint check && turbo run build typecheck lint //#lint:repo test //#knip
scripts.check:affected: dprint check && turbo run build typecheck lint //#lint:repo test //#knip --affected
